description: This file defines interfaces and classes related to the IARM bus system, including function prototypes, a class with pure virtual methods for bus operations, and external function pointer declarations. It appears to be a mock header for testing or abstracting IARM bus functionality in a C++ project.

classes.name: IarmBusImpl
classes.description: Abstract base class defining the interface for IARM bus implementations with virtual methods for initialization, connection, registration, and event handling.

classes.name: IarmBus
classes.description: Facade class providing static methods to interact with the IARM bus, delegating to a concrete implementation of IarmBusImpl.

methods.name: setImpl
methods.description: Sets the static implementation pointer for the IarmBus class.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_Init
methods.description: Initializes the bus system with a given name.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_Connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the bus.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_IsConnected
methods.description: Checks if the bus is connected.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_RegisterEventHandler
methods.description: Registers an event handler for a specific event.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_UnRegisterEventHandler
methods.description: Unregisters an event handler for a specific event.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_RemoveEventHandler
methods.description: Removes a previously registered event handler.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_Call
methods.description: Makes a call on the bus to the specified method.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_BroadcastEvent
methods.description: Broadcasts an event to all registered listeners.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_RegisterCall
methods.description: Registers a callback for a specific bus method.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_Call_with_IPCTimeout
methods.description: Makes a bus call with an IPC timeout.
